source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chromosomal theory (PDF 100).

blocks.text: 1900 mein German mahir-e-genetics Karl Correns ne Mendel ka kaam dobara daryaft kiya aur virasat mein chromosomes ke kirdar ki taraf ishara kiya. 1902 mein American scientist Walter Sutton ne virasat ka chromosomal nazariya (theory) pesh kiya.

blocks.title: Virasat ka chromosomal nazariya
blocks.text: Genes chromosomes par khaas jaghon par hote hain. Meiosis mein chromosomes ka rawaiya Mendel ke virasat ke qawaneen ki wazahat karta hai.

blocks.caption: Mendel ke qawaneen aur chromosomes ka rawaiya
header: Meiosis mein chromosomes kya karte hain
rows: Har khasiyat ke do factors, har gamete mein aik (segregation)
Do alleles wale homologous chromosomes meiosis I mein alag gametes mein jate hain.
Mukhtalif khasiyatein azadana alag hoti hain
Mukhtalif homologous jore ittefaqan qatar banate hain, is liye mukhtalif chromosomes ke genes azadana alag hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Virasat ka chromosomal nazariya kis ne aur kab pesh kiya?
blocks.explanation: Walter Sutton ne 1902 mein, jab Karl Correns 1900 mein Mendel ka kaam dobara daryaft kar chuke the.

items: Correns 1900: Mendel dobara daryaft; Sutton 1902: chromosomal nazariya.
Genes chromosomes ke loci par; meiosis Mendel ke qawaneen samjhata hai.
